buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Supply The scope of supply includes the delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning of laboratory equipment , apparatus, glassware, and associated hardware items as specified in the Bill of Quantities (BoQ) at the d esignated consignee location. 2. Bidder Eligibility & Technical Qualification Criteria OEM Authorization: If the bidder is not the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), they must furnish a vali d authorization certificate from the respective OEM specific to this tender. Past Performance / Experience: The bidder should have successfully executed similar supplies of laborator y or scientific equipment to Central/State Government departments, PSUs, or reputed educational/researc h institutions in the last 3 financial years. Relevant purchase orders or completion certificates must be upl oaded. Financial Standing: Average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years sho uld be at least as per GeM bid criteria or a minimum of 30% of the estimated bid value. 3. Compliance & Product Standards All items (such as Digital Hot Air Ovens, Muffle Furnaces, Hydrothermal Autoclave Reactors, Weight Balanc es, and Glassware) must strictly conform to the technical specifications, dimensions, and capacities mentioned in the inventor y list. Calibration certificates from NABL-accredited laboratories must be provided wherever applicable (e.g., Wei ght Balances, Density Bottles). Electrical appliances (Ovens, Furnaces, Distillation units, Water Filters) must be compatible with s tandard Indian power supply (230V ± 10%, 50Hz) and carry appropriate safety certifications (CE / ISO compliance). 4. Delivery & Execution Timeline Delivery Period: All items must be delivered and installed within 30 to 45 days from the date of issuance of the Supply Order /Contract. Liquidated Damages (LD): In case of delay in supply or installation beyond the stipulated delivery period, a penalty @ 0.5% of the total order value per week of delay, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total contra ct value, will be levied. 5. Warranty & Maintenance Support Standard Warranty: All equipment (particularly electronic and mechanical instruments like Ovens, Furnace s, Balances, and Autoclaves) shall carry a comprehensive warranty of at least 1 year (or manufacturer's standard warranty, whichever is higher) from the date of successful installation and sign-off by the consignee. Service Response Time: During the warranty period, any breakdown or defect reported must be attended t o within 48 hours, and rectification must be completed within 5 working days. 6. Inspection, Testing, and Acceptance Pre-dispatch inspection (if applicable) or thorough joint inspection at the consignee site will be carried out upon delivery.

Acceptance and Inspection Reports (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate - CRAC) will be issued o nly after successful verification of item quantities, physical condition, and operational testing of equipment. 7. Packaging & Transit Insurance All items, especially fragile glassware (Density Bottles, Pycnometers, Aspirator Bottles, Distillation Set) and sensitive instruments, must be securely packed in tamper-proof, export-grade wooden crates or heavy-dut y cartons to prevent transit damage. Transit insurance from warehouse to consignee site shall be the sole responsibility and liability of the supplier. .
